description: This file defines the VerticalTabs class for rendering vertical tabs in Drupal forms, including methods for processing and pre-rendering the element, and managing active tab state.

classes.name: VerticalTabs
classes.description: A render element class for vertical tabs in Drupal forms, providing processing, pre-rendering, and accessibility features.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns the default properties and processing callbacks for the vertical tabs element.

methods.name: preRenderVerticalTabs
methods.description: Prepares the vertical tabs element for rendering, hiding it if it has no visible children.

methods.name: processVerticalTabs
methods.description: Processes the vertical tabs element, injecting necessary details, managing active tab state, and attaching libraries.
